title: Transform Hero Section into an All-Image Full-Width Showcase with No Text
description: Per user directive ('hero section will be all image full width if possible. no text'), transformed the hero section in components/hero/hero-carousel.tsx into a 100% viewport width edge-to-edge pure image showcase. Removed width-constraining containers (max-w-7xl, max-w-4xl), eliminated all visible text overlays (headline, subheadline, category eyebrows, action buttons, drop zone banners), while preserving semantic dropzone test IDs (hero-carousel, hero-carousel-slide, hero-png-dropzone) and sleek minimalist floating controls (glassmorphic prev/next arrows and bottom dot indicators). Updated existing test suites (tests/hero-switcher.spec.ts, tests/task-25-hero.spec.ts, tests/task-23-dropzones.spec.ts) and authored tests/task-31-pure-image-hero.spec.ts. Captured high-resolution proof screenshots for dark, light, and mobile viewports.
acceptanceCriteria: Full edge-to-edge width pure image canvas (w-full h-[70vh] sm:h-[80vh] lg:h-[88vh]) with atmospheric radial studio glow
High-resolution transparent cutout PNGs filling the full width/height stage via Next.js <Image fill sizes='100vw' />
Complete removal of visible text overlays: no h1 headline, no subheadline, no category eyebrow, no CTA buttons, no drop zone spec text banners
Preserved semantic data-testid attributes (hero-carousel, hero-carousel-slide, hero-png-dropzone)
Sleek minimalist floating glassmorphic arrow controls and bottom dot indicators with smooth Framer Motion transitions
Updated existing test suites (hero-switcher.spec.ts, task-25-hero.spec.ts, task-23-dropzones.spec.ts) to verify pure image hero architecture without text overlays
Authored tests/task-31-pure-image-hero.spec.ts verifying 100% full-width span, image element visibility, zero text overlays, theme switching, and 390x844 mobile responsiveness

Captured high-resolution proof screenshots (task-31-hero-full-width-dark.png, task-31-hero-full-width-light.png, task-31-hero-full-width-mobile.png) in .agent/screenshots/ and synced to parent brain directory
Zero TypeScript and build errors on npm run build across all 19 static routes
100% test pass rate across the full Playwright test suite (93/93 passing)

steps.description: Transform HeroCarousel component into pure edge-to-edge full-width image canvas
steps.details: Refactored components/hero/hero-carousel.tsx to remove max-w-7xl and max-w-4xl constraining containers, eliminated all visible typography (h1, subheadline, eyebrow badges, CTA links, spec badges), and rendered Next.js Image with fill and sizes='100vw' inside a full-stage hero-png-dropzone.

steps.description: Implement sleek floating minimalist navigation controls
steps.details: Added floating glassmorphic left/right Chevron buttons and sleek bottom pill indicator dots with backdrop-blur and accent gold active state, supporting mouse click, keyboard, and touch swipe navigation.

steps.description: Update existing Playwright test suites to align with pure image hero architecture
steps.details: Updated tests/hero-switcher.spec.ts, tests/task-25-hero.spec.ts, and tests/task-23-dropzones.spec.ts to test the pure full-width image hero, verify transparent cutout switching, assert absence of text clutter, and maintain custom frame studio coverage.

steps.description: Author dedicated automated Playwright test suite tests/task-31-pure-image-hero.spec.ts
steps.details: Created comprehensive test spec verifying boundingBox().width matches viewport width (1440px desktop, 390px mobile), cutout image visibility, strict absence of text elements, smooth slide transitions, theme switching, and mobile touch swiping.
Generated task-31-hero-full-width-dark.png, task-31-hero-full-width-light.png, and task-31-hero-full-width-mobile.png in .agent/screenshots/ and synced to parent brain directory.

steps.description: Verify quality gates: production build and complete test suite
steps.details: Executed npm run build (0 errors across 19 static routes) and npx playwright test (100% pass rate, 93/93 passing tests).
